description: Explicit, source-backed administrative localities and districts named in project titles; these complement numbered-barangay and zone evidence.

records.basis: Malate is an administrative district of Manila and falls in Manila's Fifth Congressional District. DPWH City-Municipal Boundaries also identifies the Malate polygon as Manila City (Fifth District).
records.limits: This crosswalk resolves an explicitly named Malate, Manila locality. It does not imply a project point, barangay, sponsorship, or control.
